reviews.text: It’s 10:22 and the door is still locked. I walked a hot minute to get here just to not be « open » (they’re supposed to open at 10am)
Cute store with a good selection.

First of all, the supposed nail clipping specialist Fatima cancelled us 3 times before she showed up. Her heart is not in it and she does everything else but properly clip your dogs nails. She files the nail slightly, and shaves the hair around the nail but barely shaves off anything. It's like she's afraid. Won't be returning! And the price for this is nonsense!

We go to Pattes&Griffes every day for my dog ​​Chihiro. She knows the way by heart. She's very spoiled by the store staff, especially Summer, the manager, who is amazing. The staff are always so attentive to our four-legged friends and offer excellent advice. It's by far the Pattes&Griffes with the best customer service! I only shop there.

Amazing employee, her name is Summer.  Very knowledgeable.  Prices are good, better than at Mondou, although sometimes out of stock.

However Summer makes it more human.  She is an amazing human being, rarely found today.  NO, I am not her friend,  nor paid to say nice things about her.  Was just amazed with her knowledge, sincerity and being a genuine human.

The employees make this store 5stars. My dog drags me in on our daily walks for a few treats and some extra care and attention. The manager Summer is so friendly and helpful, and with Louis they have even helped train my chi. Super knowledgeable staff. To be noted though, I often need to wait a long time for certain items to come back into stock, but the employees make it a worthwhile stop for me

I had such a great experience at this pet store thanks to Nick. He took the time to listen to me, gave me the best recommendations, and even went out of his way to find the right products for my cat’s condition. You can tell he really cares about animals and making sure customers leave with exactly what they need. Truly outstanding service, I’ll definitely be coming back!
Louis provided excellent service; I highly recommend the place. There's also a shop nearby, and I found a brush there to detangle the knots in my big cat's fur. Thank you!
Great experience! The groomer, Eddie, was absolutely amazing. He took such good care of my dog and did an excellent job. The staff was also very friendly.
Eddie is great and Willow loves him!
So happy! This is my second time there and my little dog is always perfect.

I had a wonderful experience with the people who helped me with my 15-year-old dachshund, advising her on food and helping her with what she could eat at the end of her life. Eddie welcomed her so gently; she felt completely at ease, and the grooming was beautiful, and the little perfumes were amazing! My little Pebbles is no longer with us, but they made her last months more comfortable. Thank you all!
Eddie and Fatima are great groomers :)
Eddie is an amazing groomer! Highly recommend!

The staff at the place is super nice! Eddie, Benito's groomer, always listens to what I ask for and delivers each time. Beyond the great service, Benito always seems to come out happy from his grooming appointment, which is what matters to me the most. I recommend!
Excellent, professional and efficient grooming

Eddie is truly the best groomer for our poodle. He's always attentive, precise in his work, and takes the time to do things properly. Our dog is relaxed, well-treated, and we feel he's in good hands every time.
Eddie is an excellent professional; he explains everything that will be done and treats the dogs with great affection.
Eddie is the best groomer ever!

I went to Patte et Griffes and had my dog attended by Eddie. He’s done a superb job on getting her nails trimmed and the additional fur she had on her paws removed. He also helped cleaning her ears and brushing her as a courtesy. It was a really great service, I recommend!

Eddie is an amazing groomer!

He's patient and talented. He always makes my Gustave (a fox terrier who doesn't usually like getting his hair cut) look fantastic!
Excellent grooming service, Edi is efficient and super caring with the animals! My dog Xico loves him too!

@griffintown
They have the best grooming service. Eddie is so handsome with my little Yorkie. She always leaves so happy and beautiful. Thank you for your service!!!! We love her so much!!!!
Eddie took great care of my Nina, she came out calm and beautiful! (For a dog who gets very stressed) I recommend him.
Excellent grooming services. Eddy is very attentive; he truly loves animals, and it shows. The cut is always beautiful and reasonably priced. I highly recommend him!

Eddie is an exceptional groomer in Griffintown on Notre-Dame! My dog ​​is usually timid, but from the very first time he went to Eddie, he looked so comfortable. His grooming is perfect, and his cuts for small dogs are adorable! I'm a loyal customer, and that means a lot because I'm quite particular!

First and last time. Arrived less than 7 minutes before closing. No "hello" or "Can I help you?" Just "We're closing in 5 minutes." I had to ask her if she had a particular product. I seemed to be bothering her. I tried to be polite, explaining that I understood since I also work Saturdays. I was met with a forced, curt smile. Despite making a $70 purchase in two minutes.

It doesn’t deserve a 1 star, but it could definitely improve on service and products they carry. I’ve been to other pattes et griffes and they have less products. Compared to other brands as well. But keep it up, keep building and you’ll be up to speed with the competition. Thanks for offering what you do.

Staff not smiling, not friendly.
Aisle half empty.
And they didn't even say hello.
The only problem is the fact that this store never has ( persian royal canin cat food ) unfortunately.we've checked 5 or 6 times and we have to go somewhere else.

Not a vibe. Spent a bunch of money (seriously a bunch because their markups are frankly ridiculous) with them over the past year in the hopes of supporting a local business instead of using Amazon. When I had a single complaint about an item with the hopes of making an exchange I was given the run around and effectively told "only the manager (who is here only in the morning, unless you're here in the morning in which case they're only here in the afternoon) can make that decision". Ridiculous not to have a clear, solid policy that any employee can enforce, that leaves customers feeling good about their experience. I will be taking a longer walk to shop at a different pet store from now on.

I love the staff. The young lady who works weekdays is super nice and knowledgeable. My 2 dogs love their walks and straight away heads to the store. It's sad the employees had to suffer with no air conditioning all summer and still. The shelves are bare, and the ceiling looks like it's going to fall down. It needs a face lift. Other than that we go and visit the wonderful staff.

The workers are really nice but the store sucks. Everything They have that Mondou carries is expensve.  was a loyal customer when they opened but after 4 years they 'lost' all my points that you save to redeem and the incentive to shop, and …
The number of times I show up and find it closed for no reason is starting to get really annoying. …

Disappointed by the return policy and poor customer service.

In December 2023, I bought a few cans of Acana puppy food. Unfortunately, after …
